headline: Presidential order updating pay rates for certain federal government jobs, signed in early January 2008.
what_it_does: This executive order adjusts the pay rates for certain federal positions. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to put new federal pay schedules into effect. No summary was provided, so the specific amounts and which pay schedules changed are not stated here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the new schedules set by this order.
